name: I'm Your Favorite Ghostie Catgirl! Right?
source:
"I'm Your Favorite Ghost Catgirl! Right?" is a comedy dating sim based off of the vtuber GhostiePurrs. It includes a date at borgors for you, an exciting walk to meet friends of Ghostie and heading home to enjoy the night with Ghostie!

[Edited from [url=https://ghostiepurrs.itch.io/im-your-favorite-ghostie-catgirl-right]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《I'm Your Favorite Ghost Catgirl! Right?》是一款以虚拟主播GhostiePurrs为原型的喜剧恋爱模拟游戏。你将与她去borgors约会，踏上一段令人兴奋的散步旅程，结识Ghostie的朋友们，最后回家，与Ghostie共度夜晚！

[根据[url=https://ghostiepurrs.itch.io/im-your-favorite-ghostie-catgirl-right]itch.io[/url]介绍整理]
